prOriginal.nota: Found via commit history of InfinispanIdentityProviderStorageProvider.java: squash commit 3e597722 'Add cache for IdentityProviderStorageProvider.getForLogin (#32918)'. PR head sha equals benchmark head e944e2ac; the squash tree is identical to the benchmark head for all 4 touched files.

add-caching-support-for-identityprovider.reason: In testCacheIDPForLogin the per-loop cleanup get("alias")::remove was changed to get(alias)::remove with alias = "idp-alias-"+i in PR #46970 (commit message: 'Fixed a flaky test'), and the same fix was applied to the org-idp loop. The remaining get("alias") cleanup for idp-alias-20 survived until the test was migrated in PR #48163 (2026-04-17), which now cleans up with findAll().forEach(remove). Today no cleanup targets the literal "alias".

Today getForLogin on main still does, on a partial miss, cache.invalidateObject(cacheKey); loaded = cache.getCurrentRevision(cacheKey); new IdentityProviderListQuery(loaded, ..., cached, query); cache.addRevisioned(query, cache.getCurrentCounter()), and IdentityProviderListQuery's second constructor still copies previous.searchKeys without validation. File history since the merge (ordering, imports, multi-org ids) never touched this merge logic.

update() on main still passes getById(...) (org-aware wrapper whose isEnabled is false when the linked organizations are disabled) as original to registerIDPLoginInvalidationOnUpdate, which still returns early when the predicate fails for both. BROKER_PUBLIC was removed from getLoginPredicate in PR #32668 (2024-09-20) and 'private' is now hideOnLogin=true, which is still in the predicate, so the same skip happens; org enable/disable does not invalidate login caches and the cache-hit path does not recheck visibility.

astra.pergunta: #08/#opa-01/#14 sent together: bug text, head vs today code of update()/registerIDPLoginInvalidationOnUpdate/getLoginPredicate, PR #32668 removing BROKER_PUBLIC, PR #36876 test; asked status for each. #08: pendente or descontinuado, given BROKER_PUBLIC replaced by hideOnLogin?
astra.resposta: Pendente: the hideOnLogin swap keeps the mechanism (original disabled via org wrapper, updated ineligible because hidden, invalidation skipped, cache keeps the IDP).

add-caching-support-for-identityprovider.reason: The migrated testCacheIDPForLogin (tests/base/.../organization/cache/OrganizationCacheTest.java) still discards every getForLogin stream and asserts only IdentityProviderListQuery sizes, querying each mode once after each invalidation. PR #36876 (2025-02-07) added IdentityProviderTest.testFindForLoginPreservesOrderByAlias, which asserts returned aliases, but on a single first (miss) call, so a cache hit is still never exercised and checked.

astra.pergunta: #08/#opa-01/#14 sent together: bug text, head vs today code of update()/registerIDPLoginInvalidationOnUpdate/getLoginPredicate, PR #32668 removing BROKER_PUBLIC, PR #36876 test; asked status for each. #14: does the PR #36876 ordering test close the gap?
astra.resposta: Pendente: the ordering test covers result assembly on a miss but not results served from an already populated cache; the original test still asserts nothing returned.

add-caching-support-for-identityprovider.reason: The `orgId == null || BROKER_PUBLIC` clause added to LoginFilter.getLoginPredicate was removed two days after the merge by PR #32668, which dropped the kc.org.broker.public attribute altogether in favour of hideOnLogin; the change targets the attribute, not this bug. Today getLoginPredicate is only nonNull + ENABLED + LINK_ONLY + HIDE_ON_LOGIN, so the base IdentityProviderBean no longer filters linked IdPs by organization.

astra.pergunta: #08/#opa-01/#14 sent together: bug text, head vs today code of update()/registerIDPLoginInvalidationOnUpdate/getLoginPredicate, PR #32668 removing BROKER_PUBLIC, PR #36876 test; asked status for each. #opa-01: confirmado or descontinuado?
astra.resposta: Descontinuado: removing the org/BROKER_PUBLIC clause in #32668 eliminated the condition, as part of replacing the attribute, not a targeted fix.
